structured.answer: I didn't really decide. I'd lean a bit towards one of the S&P 500 tracker tracks, like "גמל עוקב מדד S&P500" at 0.53%, because that's what friends talk about. But with 182 tracks that all look the same and no recommendation, I'd do nothing today.

stuck.why: Endless rows of near-identical tracks from different companies, no 'best' or recommended marker, so I couldn't pick
Two fees per row, didn't know which one is the real cost
Percents over 100% ('101%') and two numbers that don't add up, confusing
Looking for a summary or recommendation, found only more rows and grey notes

used: Track names on the right of the table
Big green return numbers (3 שנים / 5 שנים)
skimmed: Filter chips row (כלוי, עוקב מדד s&p 500, מניות...)
skipped: Grey notes at bottom of table and footer
unsure_meaning: ניהול אישי: כל חוסך מחליט במה להשקיע
Circle chart colours (guessed green = shares, yellow = foreign currency)
not_found: A simple summary of which S&P track is cheapest overall

findings.what: 182 tracks in one long list with no recommendation or shortlist, too many look-alike options
Two separate fees per track (מהחיסכון / מההפקדות) with no explanation of which matters
Fees only as tiny percents, no shekel amount, so they all feel like nothing
Exposure percents over 100% and pairs that don't add up
Returns are 'לפני דמי ניהול', so the big numbers may mislead
Same S&P 500 track appears at several companies, hard to compare across the page
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' or 'עוד לא דווח' instead of numbers
קופה number column means nothing to me
